profile_text.body:
Meta's developer site describes building with Meta's AI models and tools, with access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The company says Muse Spark is tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. The site also describes a quick start that points an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and search grounding that gives a model live access to the web by adding a single tool to a request. Muse Image is offered on the Meta Model API at $0.01/image, described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, with anchored composition for consistent edits.

The product tracked for Meta is Llama (Meta), an open-weight model family in the Chat and General LLMs category that is often self-hosted. Meta is a public company, ticker META, CIK 0001326801, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA. Its most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting $200,966,000,000.

Litigation associated with Meta includes 264 cases in California and named suits: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. MCP servers registered in connection with Meta cover advertising and other functions, among them ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as a Meta Ads server with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights; co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp for Facebook and Meta Ads automation; com.adbloop/meta-ads for bulk-creating Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders; ai.fastmetal/fastmetal for running and comparing LLMs and generating images and video; ai.livingmeta/ai-in-research, a read-only server over a corpus of 12,400 papers; ai.primeta/primeta for 3D avatars with custom personas; and app.metadock/metadock for controlling the MetaDock desktop workspace.
